patterns.summary: For a large translation unit, moving object definitions before code can alter one-pass visibility, register allocation, text size, and BSS even when equivalent declarations remain visible.
patterns.conditions: Observed in mdparty.c with 73 same-owner objects; do not generalize to every owner without a local probe.

patterns.summary: Adding a semantically correct broad header may change calls or allocation when the retail translation unit saw only a narrower local declaration set.
patterns.conditions: Use exact target-backed local declarations only when an owner-specific probe proves broad visibility wrong; never copy this as a global style rule.

patterns.summary: Helper boundaries, automatic inlining, signed-short contracts, and block-scoped lifetimes can be authentic source-shape evidence when they reproduce multiple callers without regressions.
patterns.conditions: Require a target or sibling-backed family of call sites; a single isolated 100% result is insufficient.
